name: OperantSolo webhook replay - sequential learning baseline

parameters.content:
## Fictional replay learning lab
POST fictional events only. No credentials or customer data.
Static state is a baseline for sequential runs, NOT atomic locking.
The action is a counter; 429/503 are generated by this mock.
The 202 review case models uncertainty, NOT a real network timeout.
Do not use as a production payment or order handler.
